description: A FastAPI module defining REST API endpoints for a job portal application. It includes routes for managing users, profiles, jobs, and applications with role-based access control and data validation.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router object to define API endpoints

methods.name: create_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Registers a new user and initializes profile if role is job seeker.

methods.name: get_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user's public profile info.

methods.name: get_user(user_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches user details by ID, restricted to admin role.

methods.name: update_user( user_id: int, user: UserUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates user information; can be self or admin.

methods.name: delete_user( user_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Deletes a user account; admin only.

methods.name: update_profile( profile: ProfileUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.job_seeker)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Allows a job seeker to update their own profile.

methods.name: create_job( job: JobCreate, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Employers create a new job posting.

methods.name: list_jobs( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Free-text search"), location: Optional[str] = None, remote: Optional[bool] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = Query(None, description="Filter by skills/tags"), skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Search and filter available job postings.

methods.name: get_job(job_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific job posting by ID.

methods.name: update_job( job_id: int, job: JobUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Employers can update their job postings.

methods.name: delete_job( job_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Remove a job posting, employer or admin only.

methods.name: create_application(app: ApplicationCreate, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.job_seeker)), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Job seekers apply for a job; prevents duplicate applications.

methods.name: get_application(app_id: int, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetch a specific job application with role-based access.

methods.name: update_application( app_id: int, update: ApplicationUpdate, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Employers update application status and notes.
